mapper.select: SELECT pq.qu_type AS quType, COUNT(1) AS total, SUM( CASE WHEN pq.is_right = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS rightCount FROM el_paper_qu pq INNER JOIN el_paper p ON pq.paper_id = p.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.exam_id = #{examId} AND pq.answered = 1 AND pq.is_right IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pq.qu_type ORDER BY pq.qu_type

SELECT -- el_paper_qu 答题记录字段 pq.id, pq.paper_id AS paperId, pq.qu_id AS quId, pq.qu_type AS quType, pq.answered, pq.answer, pq.sort, pq.score, pq.actual_score AS actualScore, pq.is_right AS isRight, -- el_qu 题目信息字段 qu.content AS quContent, qu.analysis AS quAnalysis, -- 核心：关联 el_qu_answer 获取选项内容，拼接为 abc:content:is_right GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS(':', pqa.abc, qua.content, pqa.is_right) ORDER BY pqa.sort SEPARATOR ';') AS options, -- 正确答案标识（abc 字段，如 B/B,C） GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pqa.is_right = 1 THEN pqa.abc END ORDER BY pqa.sort SEPARATOR ',') AS correctAnswerStr FROM el_paper_qu pq -- 关联题目表 LEFT JOIN el_qu qu ON pq.qu_id = qu.id -- 关联选项标识/正确性表（el_paper_qu_answer） LEFT JOIN el_paper_qu_answer pqa ON pq.paper_id = pqa.paper_id AND pq.qu_id = pqa.qu_id -- 关联选项内容表（el_qu_answer）：通过 answer_id 关联 LEFT JOIN el_qu_answer qua ON pqa.answer_id = qua.id WHERE pq.paper_id = #{paperId} -- 分组：确保每题只返回一条记录 GROUP BY pq.id, pq.paper_id, pq.qu_id ORDER BY pq.sort ASC
